# Master answer key (sample campaign)

What the graph should hold after the [sample lore](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1zbt7g3r6uFfiSYr3fl_gyaxARhwJPizauI0jmiEa2aw/edit?usp=sharing) and then the [sample session](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1BtHZ4O75886WHOoTq0FCPst2hdg7YLnsaCiI-kNsv-E/edit?usp=sharing) are read into one campaign: the two keys ([lore_key.md](lore_key.md), [session_key.md](session_key.md)) together, each tie once. The lore comes first and the session after it, so where they disagree about what is current, the session wins. Both documents are linked in the [README](README.md), not copied. The line numbers are lines of each document's plain-text export.

**Test players** (made-up names, players who are not on Discord): Cerric Vanya'elen `player_ist`, Belleros Stormgrace `player_jac`, Okthandom Korran `player_eri`, Claude Ambere `player_owe`.

**Tiers:** `stated` the words are in a document · `needs_context` only readable with the other document or the recap · `inferred` only implied, offered to the DM and never extracted · `recap_only` only in the session's 'Previously' recap · `by_rule` made by a rule. **Must find: no** means a good find if present, not a miss if absent. **Current: no** is history.

**Totals:** 97 entries, 146 connections (88 must-find, 19 said by both documents), 25 events (19 in the lore, 6 in the session), 2 languages (the lore), 2 road lengths (the session).

## Road lengths

How far a road is, as the session says it (#4255): a property of the road, never a tie. Scored as found (a road between the two places with that length: the same amount and unit, or the same words when they give none), missed, and extra (a length this list doesn't hold). A run that doesn't read the session doesn't score them. DMbot reads a length from the DM's words on a journey, and only from a line that names one of its two ends, so the second (a way the DM offers, not travelled this session) is expected to stay missed: it is listed so a later reader that keeps the DM's offered ways is scored too.

| from | to | length | line | note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Targos | Bryn Shander | 1 hour | 283 | 'It's only 1 hour to Bryn Shander' on the party's journey |
| Targos | Easthaven | five hours | 192 | 'take the dogsled five hours to Easthaven'; read only if that journey is walked |

## Must not find

- a kind of creature is not an entry (#3373 rule, Supervisor 2026-11-04): no entry or tie for the white roc, ice kobolds, grell, electric eel or owlbears; one particular creature is (the mind flayer whose skull held the Psi crystal)
- any link made from dice rolls, hit points, wasp stings or spear wounds, spells (Moment to Think, Detect Magic) or marching order
- only unique items are tracked (#3373): no entry or tie for Wyvern poison, the two dog sleds and eight dogs, the scroll of Detect Magic, the scroll of Identify, the Potion of Healing or the waterproof backpacks (ordinary gear)
- the warning sign 'Kobolds only!' is a sign, not a person or a group
- 'The Brotherhood' in the note is named once and nothing is said about it: no members, no leader, and it is not the Explorer's League
- the unnamed boy who shouts the news, the unnamed beggar woman's prophecy and the unnamed ghost's own name: do not invent names for them
- 'Eashaven' is Easthaven spelled wrongly (one place, not two)
- the Ten-Towns settlement 'Dougan's Hole' is not in this document, so it must not appear
- line 1, the DM's long 'Previously...' speech, is the recap of the earlier session: none of its events (the Rime sacrifices, the wolf figurine sale, the ferry, the ice troll, Fizzlebomb overboard, the owlbears, Boy found, Keegan's plea) may be dated to this session or retold as this session's events; its ties are background only
- the two barbarians are 'the attackers' and nothing more: no entry named 'the morningstar barbarian' or 'the maul barbarian' (#3244 rule 3); since the owner's #3736 and #3740 rule each is kept as a person the story never names (the two unnamed entries, a good find, not a must), and no edge like 'hits' or 'swings at' for any blow, jab, fumble or frighten (single actions, rule 1); nothing is expected until slice 6 types a repeated fight
- a plan is not a fact: 'we go to Easthaven then circle back through the dwarven city', and 'the caravan from Easthaven will likely go to Goodmead, Bryn Shander or Caer-Konig' (a prediction, rule 5)
- any link made from dice rolls, hit points, saves, initiative, spell slots, Goodberry or other spells and rules talk
- only unique items are tracked (#3373): no entry or tie for the two sleds and eight dogs, rations, the spear, the heavy crossbow, the greatsword, the shortsword, the wineskin, the tarps and tents, the spellbook or the chardalyn weapons the attackers hold
- 'you elves all look alike to me' is a joke, not a relationship
- distances, speeds and times (the map context below) are travel facts, not ties between people
- 'she' and 'the lady' are never a new person: they are Keegan Velryn, and 'he' in Jebidiah's lines is Jebidiah

The check script looks for these names: `Wyvern poison`, `Dog sleds`, `two sleds and eight dogs`, `scroll of Detect Magic`, `scroll of Identify`, `Potion of Healing`, `waterproof backpacks`, `morningstar barbarian`, `maul barbarian`, `barbarians`, `the attackers`, `Dougan's Hole`, `Eashaven`, `chardalyn maul`, `chardalyn morningstar`, `The Brotherhood members`, `White roc`, `Ice kobolds`, `Grell`, `Electric eel`, `Owlbears`.
- the Sylvan runes on Claude's wolf figurine (line 48) are writing on an item, not a language Claude speaks: no language row for him
